lines.x: The Reserve Bank of Australia increased its cash rate to its highest level in 18 years in a majority board decision aimed at dampening inflation and warding off price pressures.
Australian and Chinese airline stocks advanced following a sharp drop in crude oil prices exceeding 7%.
The Reserve Bank of Australia's chief signaled a pause in monetary tightening following a split decision on the latest rate hike, noting prior tightening has yet to fully feed through to the economy.
The High Court of Australia determined that rideshare company Uber owes payroll tax in New South Wales, amounting to $81 million.
